description: Vietnam Disaster Monitoring System (VNDMS) is published by Vietnam disaster management authorities. VNDMS displays disaster-monitoring layers, rain warnings and river-level alerts. Its stated coverage is Vietnam; national monitoring interface. Further dates and resolution are unknown unless specified by the provider. The provider page describes access through listed XLSX, PDF resources; the underlying files or applications were not downloaded or run. The inspected public resource is free to access. The inspected page does not state a reusable licence. The displayed layer catalogue was inspected; live-feed accuracy and bulk export were not verified. For simulation, it can inform emergency-response planning and comparisons of demand against available resources; this is a reviewer assessment of potential use. Related record model-jemss provides a comparison in the same service area; technical compatibility was not tested.
